english.title: Obstruct an officer in exercise of powers under section 99ZB or 99ZF of the Transport Act 1968
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) obstructed **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), an officer authorised for that purpose by the Transport Act 1968, exercising a power

(A)_[of entry into a vehicle or premises under section 99ZB of the Act]_
(B)_[to seize documents under section 99ZF of the Act]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 99ZD(1)(b) and (2) of the Transport Act 1968.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket - Three hundred pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
